_comment: Persona names for the free-model lanes. Each Claude specialist has a shadow worker per provider: Chinese names on DeepSeek (external), Mexican/Italian names on local Ollama. by_role maps the Claude agent 'name' to its shadow's call-name. Ollama also carries a 'pool' of extra local workers -- while DeepSeek is dormant, the local bench does all the offloaded work, so it is staffed deeper.
